newsitem.title: SWEDEN: P&U says no plans for a profit warning.
newsitem.headline: P&U says no plans for a profit warning.

text.p: Swedish/U.S. drugs company Pharmacia & Upjohn said on Thursday that it had no plans to issue a profit warning.
The statement came amid market rumours that several U.S. players had downgraded their earnings forecasts for P&U.
"I have a comment...P&U is not planning a profit warning," P&U spokesman Soren Densjo told Reuters.
In early trade P&U shares fell as much as 16 crowns ($2.05) but at 0925 GMT had recovered some ground and were trading seven crowns lower at 265 crowns.
P&U, which was formed in November 1995 by a merger of U.S.'s Upjohn and Sweden's Pharmacia, has issued three profit warnings over the past 12 months.
-- Belinda Goldsmith, Stockholm newsroom +46-8-700 1017 ($ = 7.774 Swedish Crowns)
